sources.title: Use the public row contract
sources.description: The guide follows the component’s exposed control placement, slot, and state behavior.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (27 October build) from the team’s private package repository. The row fills its host; the optional end slot defaults to 80 px and swaps edges with the Checkbox. A string label wraps in this version; a story name alone does not imply ellipsis. On the web the row is one checkbox with one Tab stop that announces whether it is selected; Space, Enter, or a click toggles it once, and Details keeps its own Tab stop without changing the selection.
